root_cause_sites.defect: repository_runner re-applies the full ingress environment contract after the eval-stack import, so third-party import side effects are read as an ingress violation
_import_eval_stack() reaches cv2 4.11.0, which adds QT_QPA_FONTDIR and QT_QPA_PLATFORM_PLUGIN_PATH and prepends its lib directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH
the shared predicate fails in two independent branches — key set and environment digest — so a key-set-only fix reaches the same terminal at the digest branch
latent, frozen, not to be edited: the same post-import re-application in the H0 child, unreached only because five H0 invocations terminated earlier

archive verification recomputes the authorization execution domain from the verifying host's /etc/machine-id and os.getuid() and requires equality with the archived record, so a Phase-A archive verifies only on its execution host; the grant's host binding is correct at launch but must not be a live recomputation at verification time

root_cause_sites.repair_owner: the same repair PR as the child fix, as its own commit; verify_h2_measurement.py is an executed surface bound into F and is not edited by this registration. The repair should also add an H2 host-independence test — H0 has one, H2 never did

why_review_missed_it: the child was reviewed as source and exercised only through unit tests with synthetic environments; the launch probe imports the same eval stack but runs under the operator's inherited environment (run_h2_measurement.py:654), never the sanitized 17-key one, so its green result carried no information about the child's environment contract
